components.name: Thin pizza base
components.note: The thin, crisp base provides a crunchy foundation beneath the softer tomato sauce and melting mozzarella.

components.name: Tomato sauce
components.note: A generous coating of rich, tangy tomato sauce brings sweetness and acidity to balance the creamy cheese.

components.name: Mozzarella
components.note: Melting mozzarella blankets the tomato sauce, adding a creamy flavour and gooey texture against the crisp crust.

components.name: Fresh basil
components.note: A scattering of fresh basil adds an aromatic herbal finish to the tomato and mozzarella toppings.

taste:
Expect a crisp, thin base with a softer topping of tomato sauce and melting mozzarella. The contrast is the main appeal: crunch from the crust, then gooey cheese and a generous layer of sauce. Tomato brings both sweetness and tang, while the mozzarella contributes a creamy flavour rather than competing with the sauce.

Fresh basil adds an aromatic finish to that straightforward combination. With just tomato, cheese and herbs over the base, this is a pizza for diners who want those flavours to remain the focus. It is served hot from the oven and can suit sharing, though the simple topping list alone does not tell you how substantial a meal it will be.
